title: Da Nang in a day
summary: My Khe in the morning, mì Quảng for lunch, and An Thuong after dark.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.note: Swim inside the buoy line while rescuers are on duty.

approach.note: From the river side, cross the Han by car or Grab.

stops.name: An Thuong
stops.note: After dark, walk inland from the beach road into the lanes.

approach.note: Walk in from the beach road after the swim.

additions.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
additions.note: See the Cham stone on the Han if you still want an hour before the swim.

additions.name: Marble Mountains
additions.note: Climb Thủy Sơn on the way toward Hội An if the beach did not use the afternoon.

seoDescription: A one-day Da Nang plan: My Khe in the morning, mì Quảng for lunch, and An Thuong after dark.
